result.topic_en: Euler eliminates x and y from the preceding formulas to obtain a relation between v and φ, expressing tan ψ in terms of dv and dφ, and then introduces the substitution v dφ = t dv, which gives ψ = φ + arctan t.
result.transcription:
38

38. Quoniam autem in formulis praecedentibus adhuc litterae $x$ et $y$ insunt, pro determinanda relatione inter $v$ et $\phi$ eas ex calculo excludi conveniet, quod commodissime praestabitur ope aequationum $\alpha y + \beta x = \delta v \sin.\phi$ et $x = \delta v \cos.\phi$, quae differentiatae praebent:
$\alpha \partial y + \beta \partial x = \delta (\partial v \sin.\phi + v \partial\phi \cos.\phi)$ et
$\partial x = \delta (\partial v \cos.\phi - v \partial\phi \sin.\phi)$,
quarum illa per hanc divisa, ob $\partial y = p\partial x$, praebet:
$\alpha p + \beta = \frac{\partial v \sin.\phi + v\partial\phi \cos.\phi}{\partial v \cos.\phi - v\partial\phi \sin.\phi}$.
Vidimus autem esse $\alpha p + \beta = \mathrm{tg.}\,\psi$, ideoque erit nunc:
$\mathrm{tg.}\,\psi = \frac{\partial v \sin.\phi + v\partial\phi \cos.\phi}{\partial v \cos.\phi - v\partial\phi \sin.\phi}$.

39. In hujus aequationis resolutione praecipuum artificium consistit. Si scilicet statuamus $v\partial\phi = t\partial v$, ut oriatur haec aequatio:
$\mathrm{tg.}\,\psi = \frac{\sin.\phi + t\cos.\phi}{\cos.\phi - t\sin.\phi} = \frac{\mathrm{tg.}\,\phi + t}{1 - t\,\mathrm{tg.}\,\phi}$,
haec postrema formula manifesto exprimit tangentem summae duorum angulorum, quorum alter est $\phi$, alterius vero tangens $= t$, sicque horum angulorum summa aequabitur ipsi angulo $\psi$, ita ut jam sit $\psi = \phi + \mathrm{Arc.\,tg.}\,t$, quae aequatio differentiata dat $\partial\psi = \partial\phi + \frac{\partial t}{1+tt}$, qui valor in nostra aequatione principali substitutus praebet $\frac{w' v\partial\phi}{w} + \partial\phi + \frac{\partial t}{1+tt} = 0$, quo quidem parum lucrati videmur, quandoquidem haec aequatio, ob $t = \frac{v\partial\phi}{\partial v}$, adhuc differentialia secundi gradus involvit, atque adeo tres veriabilis $v$, $\phi$ et $t$ implicat, quas

items.quote: pro determinanda relatione inter $v$ et $\phi$ eas ex calculo excludi conveniet
items.english: To determine the relation between v and φ, it will be convenient to exclude them [x and y] from the calculation.

items.quote: In hujus aequationis resolutione praecipuum artificium consistit.
items.english: The principal artifice consists in the resolution of this equation.

items.quote: quo quidem parum lucrati videmur, quandoquidem haec aequatio, ob $t = \frac{v\partial\phi}{\partial v}$, adhuc differentialia secundi gradus involvit
items.english: By this we seem to have gained little, since this equation, because t = v dφ/dv, still involves differentials of the second degree.
